Monologue: So tell me, world child; what are you? A soldier, in a line of ants? A deviant ripple in a still bog?
You call it Spoilage. Like piercing your thumbs into the soured, pus-filled fruit. But to eat is to love.
Let me offer you a choice. You can choose to serve her come morning, as if I had never come to darken your door.
But you know, Little Svetka always loved her sweets.
One ends her life. The other, feeds a lonely, starving girl, begging for a bite to eat. Both prey on sentimentality.
Verehn is a city of culinary goliaths. Your palate is your palette—you are no less than an artist.
Now let's see what gluttony looks like in the starved sockets of peace, what dredges are found in the sunken hollows of war.
Who knows. Maybe you might be able to save someone after all.
